Docket No. 59611
commission staff’s STATEMENT IN LIEU OF FINAL Recommendation
On April 7, 2026, El Paso Electric Company (EPE) filed an application for approval of a new tariff applicable to very large, high-load factor customers. EPE proposes to create Schedule No. 27 - High Load Factor Large Power Service Rate (HLFLP) with an effective date of May 12, 2026. EPE also proposes the termination of Rate Schedule 33A upon approval of the proposed Schedule No. 27.
On May 29, 2026, the administrative law judge (ALJ) filed Order No. 4, requiring the Staff (Staff) of the Public Utility Commission of Texas, to file a recommendation on final disposition or to request a hearing by June 8, 2026. Therefore, this pleading is timely filed. 
STATEMENT IN LIEU OF FINAL RECOMMENDATION
On May 15, 2026, the City of El Paso requested this case be referred to the State Office of Administrative Hearings (SOAH) for a hearing on the merits. Also on May 27, 2026, the Office of Public Utility Counsel filed a request for hearing. Accordingly, Staff defers making its final recommendation in anticipation of filing testimony on any identified issues on a date the parties agree to in a forthcoming procedural schedule.
CONCLUSION
Staff respectfully requests the ALJ take note of Staff’s statement provided herein.

Dated: June 8, 2026
